title: The Weight of Expectation: A Sociology of Family, Success, and Belonging
author: Intellectual Encounters editorial project
subject: Sociology · Family, migration & belonging
description: Why social expectation feels so heavy, and where it actually comes from — norms and roles, the socially built idea of "success," how family and gender scripts form, and what it means to belong when you live between two societies.
